Game Overview

In 9x9 Rotate and Flip, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a strategic puzzle experience with 9x9 Rotate and Flip. Skillfully fit blocks onto a 9x9 grid by rotating and flipping them. Each mode—Classic, By Time, and Bombs—offers unique challenges, enhancing gameplay with time management and explosive surprises. Perfect planning and quick reflexes are your keys to success.
